rule: Lab rule, provisional (v2): a side re-orders when none of its units has an enemy in attack range and it sees at least one enemy; a unit with a destination blocks the re-order only if it moved at least 30 wu in the last 200 ticks; the order sends every unit of the side at the position of the nearest seen enemy to the side's centroid, with no chunk offsets (one group if the side fits inside the 450 wu scatter limit of E-13 R-095-03, otherwise chunks all aimed at that point); considered every mopup_interval_ticks, counted per fight, same for both sides. Setting: mopup=True, mopup_interval_ticks=200. Each fight's count is the mopup_orders column.
